features.quote: Hard caps: max turns, max wall-clock, max cost. These are also your safety rails — a battery that can't terminate is its own incident.
features.justification_quote: Loop-failure runs burn the most tokens. Your hard caps are budget control and a tested safety property — verify termination works before a large run.

features.quote: The useful version measures *where* an agent degrades so you can build guardrails... The less useful version just optimizes for 'make the model spiral,' which produces a number but no engineering signal.
features.justification_quote: optimizes for 'make the model spiral,' which produces a number but no engineering signal. The spec below is built for the former.

features.quote: If you ever tune the *battery* to maximize induction, you'll converge on adversarial nonsense prompts that tell you nothing about real-task robustness. Keep tasks plausibly realistic.
features.justification_quote: you'll converge on adversarial nonsense prompts that tell you nothing about real-task robustness
